summary: OpenAI announced it will acquire Ona, a company providing secure cloud execution and orchestration infrastructure, to extend Codex's ability to run persistent, long-running agents in customer-controlled cloud environments.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI discloses a large stated increase in weekly Codex usage, indicating rising inference volume from agentic workflows.
mechanisms.quote: More than 5 million people use Codex each week to research, analyze, build, and automate their work—up 400% from earlier this year.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement describes agents doing sustained, multi-hour or multi-day autonomous work rather than short interactive sessions, shifting the unit of work from sessions to delegated agent execution.
mechanisms.quote: As Codex becomes more capable, its most valuable work is unfolding over hours or days, rather than minutes.

practices.reason: Enterprises deploying Codex will eventually need to consider credential scoping, logging and review workflows tied to the new execution model, though no concrete change or timeline is given yet.
practices.quote: That means having control over where they run, what they can access, how credentials are scoped, how activity is logged, and how work moves through review.
